issues.title: The Windows beta installer is unsigned
issues.description: Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen. The beta has no Authenticode publisher trust or SmartScreen reputation.
issues.workaround: Verify the official release source and its published SHA-256 before opening the installer. Do not disable Windows security protections.

issues.title: Updates are installed manually
issues.description: Automatic installer download and installation are not enabled for this beta.
issues.workaround: Read the published release notes, back up your work, and install the official release manually.

issues.title: External providers require your own access
issues.description: Provider accounts, subscriptions where applicable, network access and quota are required. Model availability is controlled by the provider.
